scenarios: a worker under another key never links (401); the right token links outbound; a foreign session over the link is NOT_HOSTED; a dropped link reconnects; an expired token cannot link again
proof: the worker's outbound link under the worker token: identity by the token's key, reconnect with backoff, revocation by expiry and by the API dropping the live link, tenant isolation by the holder check on both ends; the benefit is the cloud browser's view with no inbound port (M8.8).
audit: MISSING before M8.8; built there; qualified here as the experiment.
limitations: an experiment: the link carries the view, input and control only; no revocation list; one host, not a VPC deployment; promotion is a decision-record question.
